exposure: 2011 American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) guidelines
2012 American College of Chest Physicians (ACCP) guidelines
2015 Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists (RCOG) guidelines
finding: The application of different risk stratification guidelines identified widely different proportions of cesarean delivery patients at risk of VTE, with implications for being categorized as having elevated risk and potentially receiving unnecessary pharmacologic prophylaxis.
mod_finding: This study investigated the incidence of venous thromboembolism (VTE) following cesarean delivery and the proportion of patients recommended for prophylaxis based on different guidelines.
